title: Early NFL BEST BETS & Survivor Pool Picks: Week 7 Predictions (Ep. 1106)
transcript_summary: Matt Perrault and Pat Fitzmaurice review Week 7 Survivor Pool options and early NFL betting picks. They highlight the Vikings and Texans as top Survivor selections while recommending bets on Vikings spread/under, Dolphins-Jets under, and Packers-Lions over.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: Welcome to the show for Week 7 Survivor pools and early bets. I took the Bucks in Week 2 and Rams in Week 6 and I am out.

speaker_segments.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
speaker_segments.text: I am also done in Survivor pools losing on the Rams to the Cardinals. Cardinals own SoFi Stadium right now.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: If you're still alive, congratulations. Week 7 is not an easy week. Thursday night has Bears and Patriots, would you even entertain taking Bears on Thursday?

speaker_segments.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
speaker_segments.text: I would not. Patriots are banged up but they're a live dog on Thursday night with Drake Maye.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: I agree, don't play Thursday games in Survivor. Who are you recommending for Week 7, Pat?

speaker_segments.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
speaker_segments.text: I like the Vikings at home against the Colts. The Colts passing game struggles and Brian Flores' defense in Minnesota is tough coming off a bye.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: The Vikings have won 10 straight dating back to last year. Meanwhile the Colts fired Chris Ballard. I like the Texans against the Giants for my Survivor pick.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: CJ Stroud is 25-17 ATS from game 5 on in his career. The Giants are a total mess right now.

speaker_segments.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
speaker_segments.text: I agree, tough call between Houston and Minnesota. I don't see the line dropping if McCarthy or Winston starts for the Giants.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: If you need a riskier Survivor pick, Pat likes the Jets over the Dolphins, and Denver over Arizona is another option.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: Let's move to early bets. Vikings -5.5 feels light against the Colts. Should we lay the 5.5 now?

speaker_segments.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
speaker_segments.text: I already took Minnesota -5.5. I also like Under 41.5 in Colts vs Vikings.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: I love the Under 39.5 in Dolphins vs Jets. Both offenses are inept and defensive line play dominates.

speaker_segments.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
speaker_segments.text: For our final play, we both agree on Over 52.5 in Packers vs Lions. Jordan Love and the Packers offense are clicking.

extracted_picks.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
extracted_picks.rationale: Colts passing game struggles, Brian Flores defense is strong, and Vikings are coming off a bye at home.

extracted_picks.speaker: Matt Perrault
extracted_picks.rationale: Giants are broken on offense and traveling to Houston; CJ Stroud and the Texans offense are trending up.

extracted_picks.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
extracted_picks.rationale: Line feels at least a couple points light for a strong Vikings team at home post-bye.

extracted_picks.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
extracted_picks.rationale: Hard to see Colts scoring more than 17 against Minnesota defense.

extracted_picks.speaker: Matt Perrault
extracted_picks.rationale: Both Miami and NY Jets offense are inept, setting up a low-scoring defensive battle.

extracted_picks.speaker: Matt Perrault
extracted_picks.rationale: Packers offense is firing on all cylinders with Jordan Love, and Lions won't stop them in Coors Field of NFL setting.
